snippet.title: Rotted - A Brain Rot Simulator | Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Rotted is a satirical high-stakes survival roguelite where your attention is the only currency that matters.

Your objective is simple: Scroll a tiered content feed to reach peak Brain Rot.

But the game has other plans. It throws everything it has at you to make you stop.
